description:
Find the funders that have ACTUALLY granted to ONE specific nonprofit —
the reverse of get_foundation_grants, over the real 7.5M-edge who-funds-whom
grant graph (IRS 990-PF, 2022-2026) plus identity-verified announced/web
grant records (how new and non-990 funders appear; per-entry 'source' says
which store each funder came from, and announced amounts are often not
published — they are counted, never summed).

Use this when the question is about a SINGLE org: "who funds Greater Chicago
Food Depository?", "which foundations support this nonprofit?", or to
prospect from one well-funded peer. To aggregate the same signal across
SEVERAL peer orgs, use find_funders_for_peers instead.

Pass recipient_ein when known (most precise). Otherwise pass recipient_name
and it is resolved to the best IRS-registered match — the response echoes
which nonprofit it resolved to under 'recipient'; confirm it's the org the
caller meant.

COVERAGE: US private-foundation (990-PF) grant history PLUS
identity-verified announced/web grant records — the latter is how new
funders, corporate programs, and non-990 foundations appear here.
Government grants and most donor-advised funding still do NOT appear,
so an empty result means "no tracked funder reported or announced a
grant to this org", not "this org has no funders" — say exactly that.

limit.description: Maximum number of funders to return (1-50)

min_amount.description: USD threshold (default 1000): minimum single-grant size for 990 entries; for announced entries, applied to the funder's aggregate published USD total (unpublished/non-USD amounts are never excluded by it)

nonprofit_ein.description: Alias for recipient_ein. The tool name says 'nonprofit', so MCP clients send nonprofit_ein= — accept both; recipient_ein wins when both are set.

nonprofit_name.description: Alias for recipient_name. The tool name says 'nonprofit', so MCP clients send nonprofit_name= (256 rejected calls by 2026-09-30, ticket #1890) — accept both; recipient_name wins when both are set.

recipient_ein.description: EIN of the RECIPIENT nonprofit whose funders you want.

recipient_name.description:
Name of the recipient nonprofit (resolved via the IRS
BMF registry when recipient_ein is not given).

name: find_funders_of_nonprofit
title: Find Funders of a Nonprofit
